metadata.title: Aza'ra Constellations, Festivals, and Sky Signs
metadata.notes: Single-file player-facing sky import. Legacy sky labels are not included. Constellation names and lore were revised to Aza'raan sky-signs while preserving the underlying viewer structure and sky geometry. Restored original Belavadös calendar names to the active 8-month/6-day Aza'raan calendar and restored The Star-River and The Spirit Lights while retaining The Emberchild.
metadata.illumination: No functional sun; the Veil powers Duvaen, W’iosamn, and Arvalla.

stars.name: Lamplight Brace
stars.lore: Variable lamp brace; hot blue-white emission light.

stars.name: Setrimir Diadem
stars.lore: Northward guiding jewel; its height mirrors the observer's northern latitude. North office star; navigation and oath witness.

stars.name: Jerbeen Tail
stars.lore: Pearl light in faint surrounding haze.

stars.name: Ishtanora Hearth
stars.lore: Compact hearth core; visible to the unaided eye in clean dark air.

stars.name: Boatbrother Glow
stars.lore: Paired glow near Kithkin Rim; variable blue-white light.

stars.name: Firbolg Horn
stars.lore: Bright western stone of the gate.

stars.name: Cyclopian Watch
stars.lore: Gate-line marker in the winter labyrinth.

stars.name: Anubaldir Stone
stars.lore: Central clustered light; heart of the winter labyrinth field.

stars.name: Goliath Horn
stars.lore: Northern horn point in the visible gate.

stars.name: Labyrinth Gate
stars.lore: Lower gate-light; bright hinge of the labyrinth.

stars.name: Minotaur Eye
stars.lore: Red-orange eye marker in the stone-and-horn field.

stars.name: Eclipse Veil
stars.lore: Long-cycle eclipsing veil; old watchers record its dimming.

stars.name: Frostmarked Shard
stars.lore: Blue-white lower frost point; a dangerous oath-star in old winter rites.

stars.name: Hornward Spear
stars.lore: Spear point closing the warfire enclosure.

stars.name: Fisherhook Line
stars.lore: Western line point; close to the sky-equator.

stars.name: Threechief Ember
stars.lore: Central bright line ember; visible from most inhabited latitudes.

stars.name: Snowbank Step
stars.lore: Eastern line point near the dark-flame fields.

stars.name: Hearthgiant Ember
stars.lore: Red shoulder ember; its changing light is watched for winter omens.

stars.name: Thri-Kreen Fang
stars.lore: Lower cup-light in the high web.

stars.name: Cnidarin Pulse
stars.lore: Faint hinge of the high web.

stars.name: Oozekin Drop
stars.lore: Brightest road-light in the high web.

stars.name: Opteran Eye
stars.lore: Close paired light with Needle-Eye Ember.

stars.name: Needle-Eye Ember
stars.lore: Companion eye-test star near Opteran Eye; used in old winter oath readings.

stars.name: Beartrail Blade
stars.lore: Blade at the end of the high trail.

stars.name: Nephthysra Glass
stars.lore: Dawn office star; bright spring herald.

stars.name: Warforged Nail
stars.lore: Bright guard-stone of the northern diadem.

stars.name: Luma Glow
stars.lore: Bright jewel in the mirror arc.

stars.name: Stolen Gear
stars.lore: Bowl-to-handle link in the northern diadem.

stars.name: Emberfade Crown
stars.lore: Fading ember; can vanish to the eye for long intervals.

stars.name: Novaflare Crown
stars.lore: Recurrent flare-light; temple watchers track its sudden returns.

stars.name: Freyseth Mask
stars.lore: Red-orange heart of the mask field.

stars.name: Merfolk Pearl
stars.lore: Paired lower-hook light with Sahuagin Fang.

stars.name: Relicborn Spark
stars.lore: Faint high handle near the turning point of the north.

stars.name: Sahuagin Fang
stars.lore: Bright fang-light at the lower hook.

stars.name: Stormblood Tail
stars.lore: Deep bright heart of the Star-River, veiled by black dust.

stars.name: Valkhamesh Prime
stars.lore: South office star; high summer watch-light.

constellations.name: Vulkiris' Chain
constellations.season: Most visible in months 6 and 8, especially at Midday, and most strongly read from Tzaphaer.
constellations.summary: A broken loop with a bright twin-star blade, remembered as the shattered chain of rebellion.
constellations.lore: Shattered bindings of oppression immortalized in the sky. In Aza’raan sky-lore, the break in the loop is the wound where Vulkiris tore false divine rule open and left a sword-shaped light behind.
constellations.appearance: A broken loop of stars with a bright twin-point like a sword hilt and blade.

constellations.name: Ruqore's Blade
constellations.season: Most visible in months 3 and 7, especially at Midday, and visible globally across Aza’ra.
constellations.summary: A bright blade-line cut by clustered lights, aligned with law, moonlight, and judgment.
constellations.lore: Formed from fragments of a tyrant god’s crown, aligned with the moons. Judges, tacticians, and oath-bearers say its three clustered lights mark law, mercy, and necessary wrath.
constellations.appearance: A long linear band of stars bisected by three radiant clusters.

constellations.name: The Screaming Crown
constellations.season: Most visible in month 5, especially in the Evening, and most strongly read from Arzuhan.
constellations.summary: A northern crown of flaring spokes and cold authority.
constellations.lore: Avinalthis’ final scream cast her wrath into the stars. Its spokes are said to be the splintered cry of a crown breaking open across the void.
constellations.appearance: A fan-shaped crown with radiant outward spokes.

constellations.name: Selkhanis' Loom
constellations.season: Most visible in months 1 and 5, especially in the Morning, and most strongly read from Dakaroth.
constellations.summary: A woven lattice of crossing threads where fate is said to be measured and tied off.
constellations.lore: Fates of the world were woven into the sky at the beginning of time. Scribes, seers, and oath-weavers study its crossings to read knots in destiny.
constellations.appearance: Intersecting lines forming a celestial loom.

constellations.name: The Emberchild
constellations.season: Most visible in month 7, especially at Midday, and most strongly read from Tzaphaer.
constellations.summary: A flameward-reaching figure of embers and child-sparks preserved in the sky.
constellations.lore: Mortal child gifted a divine spark after stealing forge fire. In this chart the child is read not as a perfect hand, but as a reaching ember-trail lifting toward a hearth-flame, which preserves the old story while matching the sky-road seen by Aza’raan astronomers.
constellations.appearance: A reaching trail of ember-bright stars ending at a central flame, with a small paired spark beside it.

constellations.name: The Broken Mirror
constellations.season: Most visible in month 5, especially in the Evening, and most strongly read from Belavadös.
constellations.summary: A fractured mirror-oval with glinting shards and a truth-cut centerline.
constellations.lore: Wielded by Ishtanora, it reveals truth and identity in reflection. The shard-stars are read as the splinters of selves seen clearly only when the whole is broken open.
constellations.appearance: A sharp-edged oval with scattered shard-stars.

constellations.name: Nyxarion's Lantern
constellations.season: Most visible in months 4 and 5, especially in the Morning, and most strongly read from Belavadös.
constellations.summary: A high lantern-road with a guiding flame and key-bright ending.
constellations.lore: Lit to guide the first soul—ever-shifting, always present. Guides, mourners, and threshold-keepers say its final trio is the hand that lifts, the flame that reveals, and the key that opens the next road.
constellations.appearance: A slender trail of stars ending in a trio read as a hand, flame, and key.

constellations.name: The Thornveil Bloom
constellations.season: Most visible in months 5 and 6, especially at Midday, and most strongly read from Arzuhan.
constellations.summary: A compact blossom of loops and a single thorn, sacred to bittersweet transformation.
constellations.lore: A sacred bloom from Sokhiva’s ascension, symbolizing bittersweet transformation. Healers and mourners alike read its offset thorn as the pain that guards new becoming.
constellations.appearance: Twisted loops of stars forming a bloom with an offset thorn-like spur.

constellations.name: The Siren's Gaze
constellations.season: Most visible in month 6, especially in the Evening, and most strongly read from Arzuhan.
constellations.summary: A sea-watch of paired eyes and curling lines, feared and revered by oathkeepers.
constellations.lore: Bastveig’s ever-watching eyes shine over oathkeepers and breakers alike. Sailors swear the gaze grows sharper before betrayal, storms, or the breaking of a promise.
constellations.appearance: Two bright eye-stars with curving sea-lines around them, like spiraled eyes gazing toward the water.

constellations.name: The Star-River
constellations.season: All year in changing segments, with the brightest river roads honored during the warm sky season.
constellations.summary: The mottled river of stars and dark rifts crossing the night.
constellations.lore: Sailors, caravan leaders, moon-priests, burial clerks, and desert-edge farmers use it as a road above roads. It braids, breaks, foams, and darkens like floodwater under two moons.
constellations.appearance: A wispy coiling trail stretching across the sky like smoke or a serpent-road.

constellations.name: Ruqore's Threefold Judgment
constellations.season: Most visible in months 4 and 8, especially at Midday, and visible globally across Aza’ra.
constellations.summary: Three ruling lights whose alignment marks the balance of judgment.
constellations.lore: The three moons watch law, mercy, and wrath; their rising reminds magistrates and priests that judgment is never singular.
constellations.appearance: Three sovereign luminous lights read as the triple offices of law, mercy, and wrath.

constellations.name: The Spirit Lights
constellations.season: Dark months, magnetic storms, funeral seasons, and nights when the upper-air curtains move.
constellations.summary: Moving curtains and crowns of colored upper air.
constellations.lore: They have no fixed star-road because they answer to storm, magnetism, darkness, and the dead. Northern provinces read these lights as the breath of restless souls and as warning that Nefarokir is turning a page of the ledger.
constellations.appearance: Two arched veils of light opening like wings around a faint central glow.
